Chĕrub , m.
		plur. Chĕrūbĭm
		(Cherubin), , plur.
		, 
I.the name
				of a rank of angels mentioned in the Old Testament, Vulg. Ezech.
				9, 3; id. Gen. 3, 24;
				Prud. Cath. 4, 4; cf.
					Hier. in Ezech. 9 and 28;
					Isid. Orig. 7, 5, 22 sq.;
				14, 3, 4; Ven. Fort. Carm. 7, 3, 131.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
